company: Bench Excavation and Civil Construction Pty Ltd (BenchHDC)
relocation_line: I will relocate to Adelaide for this role and can start two weeks after an offer.
cover_letter_text:
I am applying for the Graduate Civil Engineer role in Port Adelaide advertised on SEEK. A newly created position that covers project coordination, tendering and estimating, quality documentation and site inspections is the broad, hands-on start I want for my civil career.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D using Australian Standards, and prepared cost estimates, bills of quantities and risk registers. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As a field engineer on subdivision finishing works I assisted with site inspections and quality checks, tracked procurement and materials, and prepared site, material and progress reports. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed drawings against project requirements and kept the client up to date.

I hold an Australian driver's licence and a White Card, and I have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am based in Melton VIC and open to discussing relocation to Adelaide. I have not yet worked on directional drilling or Australian underground infrastructure projects, so I would start at graduate level and learn quickly from your drilling manager and crews.

I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.
